claims.evidence: All 12 non-liver RAW files of the PRIDE file list; every entry's projectAccessions contains PXD004245

claims.value: HeLa, CVCL_0030, Homo sapiens, 30Y6M, female, African American, cervical adenocarcinoma, uterine cervix
claims.evidence: Paper Methods: HeLa cells / SILAC HeLa cells; donor attributes from Cellosaurus CVCL_0030
peptides.txt has only Intensity L/H and Ratio H/L for SILAC experiments; msms heavy deltas +8.014/K +10.008/R; Supp Fig 4a 'Heavy (K8, R10)'
Experiments Rep1-3 have no L/H intensity columns; msms Labeling State 0 only
RAW header original path: deposited Rep1=..._2xSep-pak.raw, Rep2=..._normal.raw, Rep3=..._Filter.raw; experimentalDesignTemplate maps 2xSep-pak->Rep1, Filter->Rep2, normal->Rep3

claims.value: heavy: hydrogen peroxide 0/5/10/30/60/120 minute; light: hydrogen peroxide 0 minute
claims.evidence: Main text: light SILAC cells stimulated a few seconds with 500 uM H2O2 (~0 min), heavy for 0,5,10,30,60,120 min; Supp Fig 4a; file names

claims.value: light: olaparib 1 uM or 10 uM + H2O2; heavy: H2O2 only
claims.evidence: Main text: both light and heavy treated with H2O2, only light treated with olaparib (1 or 10 uM); file names Ola_1uM / Ola_10uM

claims.value: light untreated; heavy hydrogen peroxide 10 minute
claims.evidence: Supp Fig 4d/e legend: cells exposed to H2O2 for 10 minutes; heavy and light correspond to treated and untreated
INFERRED from general Methods 'Cells were stimulated with H2O2 for 10 min in PBS'

claims.value: Q Exactive Plus (rows 1-19); Q Exactive HF (rows 20-21)
claims.evidence: RAW header instrument strings 'Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS' / 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'; PRIDE lists Q Exactive
'NCE / stepped NCE' in RAW method header The occupancy file's NCE (28) is not in the first 64 KB of its RAW header; it rests on the paper's statement for the sensitive method.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term, ADP-Ribosyl KRDE variable; Label:13C(6)15N(2) K and Label:13C(6)15N(4) R on SILAC rows
claims.evidence: parameters.txt fixed mod and site tables 'ADP ribose (KRDE)Sites;Oxidation (M)Sites'; Methods variable mods; label masses from msms
Methods: endoproteinase Lys-C and modified sequencing grade trypsin
Methods 7 ppm peptide, 20 ppm HCD fragments; parameters.txt MS/MS tol (FTMS) 20 ppm
Methods data-dependent acquisition, HCD; TopN method header; msms Fragmentation HCD FTMS
Paper: 'we treated HeLa cells with 500 μM H2O2' (label-free triplicate); time course: light cells 500 μM H2O2, heavy cells 'the same concentration'; RAW file names contain 500uMH2O2.
H2O2 concentration for the olaparib and occupancy experiments is not stated.

limitations: Independence of light reference cultures and of the three label-free replicate enrichments not stated in the paper
Cell-line donor attributes from Cellosaurus, not the paper
No ontology term for ADP-ribose (Af1521) enrichment; characteristics[enrichment process] omitted
PRIDE disease 'brain cancer' unsupported and not used
Post-processing inserted a Lys-C cleavage column and set SILAC label mods to not applicable on 3 label-free rows (diff-verified)
